result.summary: Updates the CI documentation in the repository to match modern container setups and the current test runner structure. Rewords outdated instructions regarding QEMU binfmt support, clarifies relative paths and CI caching behavior, removes outdated notes claiming CI scripts run in numerical order, and adds documentation on pinning dependencies.
result.problem: Developers reading the CI README encounter stale and inaccurate documentation, such as references to outdated multiarch QEMU Docker images, misleading descriptions of script execution ordering, and imprecise details about cache contents.
evidence: Commit fabc10bc59 notes docker.io/multiarch/qemu-user-static hasn't been updated in years and modern container engines ship QEMU by default
Commit fa5de5cd16 notes CI scripts are not numbered in execution order (02_run_container.py runs before 01_base_install.sh)
result.card: Updates the CI README documentation to reflect the current test runner behavior and container practices. It fixes stale instructions concerning QEMU binfmt configuration, corrects directory path notes, clarifies cache scope, and notes dependency pinning policies. This addresses confusion for developers referencing or running the CI harness locally.

risk.why: Only documentation files are modified, with no impact on executable code or build outputs.
